prompt: How far ahead should an observant driver visually scan when traveling along high-speed Texas highways?

options.text: Directly at the rear bumper of the immediate vehicle directly ahead
Exclusively at the dashed lane markings on the left edge of the hood
Three to four seconds ahead to minimize visual eye fatigue over time
At least 12 to 15 seconds ahead (about one city block or one-quarter mile)
